reviews.title: Awesome and affordable x3D chip!
reviews.comment: (4/28/2026) New PC paired with a 9070xt and it's been playing my games maxed at 1440p. Quite a beast of a CPU! No issues using an aftermarket heatsink. Haven't done serious stress testing so far, but my PC have yet to crash or show instability after running for 24 hrs. I played my MMO games, sports/racing games, shooter games, VR games, insert genre here games, and my current setup is eating 'em up with ease! For gaming specifically, it's never a mistake to go with a x3D CPU for the larger L3 cache. A 7800x3D is only marginally better, if even that, than the 7600x3D in performance but it's priced at 100 dollars more at time of writing. A 9800x3D is a mild uplift over those two, but it comes in at 440 bucks. But for 230 bucks, you can grab this awesome x3D that doesn't skimp on performance while saving you money to spend on your GPU/RAM/Storage instead :P

reviews.title: Strong value per dollar
reviews.comment: Best gaming value per dollar.  I normally overclock my PCs to squeeze every drop of performance but with my 32 GB of DDR 5, my 2 Two TB SSD drives and my AIO cooler, it's already very snappy and quick yet also smooth and stable.  I'll consider overclocking later on if i desperately need minutes shaved off my loading times I guess
